title: The Treasury's Two Keys
offer: Agent! A disgruntled clerk walked out the FRONT DOOR with the Master Tax Ledger — every citizen's debts and holdings — and SOLD it to the Mega-Mart! I want the heaviest lock coin can buy. The HEAVIEST.
opener: HERALD — A heavier lock on a door the thief was allowed to open. Mayor, you don't have a lock problem. You have a RULES problem. Agent — show him the difference. Both kinds of measure, or neither works.
nextHint: Find the Mayor in the Great Hall
debrief: Interlock technical and organizational measures — locks stop strangers, rules govern the trusted, logs judge everyone.

steps.objective: Secure the Treasury against all three threats
